```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L4/401_compile_final_dataset.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
L1_data_dir <- here("data", "L1") # L1 data
L2_data_dir <- here("data", "L2") # L2 data
L3_data_dir <- here("data", "L3") # L3 data
L4_data_dir <- here("data", "L4") # L4 data
fs::dir_create(L4_data_dir)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data
reject_data <- read_rds(here(L1_data_dir, "103b_ETF_EPT_reject_annotated.rds"))
final_data <- read_rds(here(L1_data_dir, "103a_ETF_EPT_final_annotated.rds"))
```


# Finalize datasets

## ETF-EPT-iNat-2025 Dataset

```{r}
#| label: finalize-etf-ept-inat-2025
ETF_EPT_iNat_2025 <- final_data |>
  # Clean up observation data
  rename(taxon_order_id = species) |>
  mutate(
    inaturalist_url = paste0(
      "https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/",
      observation_id
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(inaturalist_url, .after = observation_id) |>
  # Add in iNaturalist metadata
  left_join(
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  select(
    # Keep observation & annotation data
    taxon_order_id:fave_image,
    # Grab extra iNat metadata
    lat,
    long,
    quality_grade,
    observed_date = observed_on_details.date,
    uuid,
    license_code,
    observer_id = user.id
  )

### Pull out observation 8413237
# During 303 validation script, this observation was incorrectly identified
# as Ephemeroptera, instead of Plecoptera
incorrect_obs <- ETF_EPT_iNat_2025 |> filter(observation_id == 8413237)

# Final dataset
ETF_EPT_iNat_2025 <- ETF_EPT_iNat_2025 |> filter_out(observation_id == 8413237)
```


```{r}
#| label: finalize-etf-ept-inat-2025-image-metadata
ETF_EPT_iNat_2025_images_meta <- ETF_EPT_iNat_2025 |>
  select(taxon_order_id:inaturalist_url) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(here(L1_data_dir, "101b_images_metadata_ETF_EPT.csv")),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  select(-species_label, -save_dir) |>
  rename(aws_image_url = clean_url) |>
  mutate(image_id = as.double(str_extract(img_name, "(?<=img)\\d+"))) |>
  relocate(image_id, .after = inaturalist_url)
```

## Excluded-Observations Dataset

```{r}
#| label: finalize-excluded-observations
excluded_observations <- reject_data |>
  rename(taxon_order_id = species) |>
  mutate(
    inaturalist_url = paste0(
      "https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/",
      observation_id
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(inaturalist_url, .after = observation_id) |>
  # Add in iNaturalist metadata
  left_join(
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  select(
    # Keep observation data
    taxon_order_id:order_id_corrected,
    # Grab extra iNat metadata
    lat,
    long,
    quality_grade,
    observed_date = observed_on_details.date,
    uuid,
    license_code,
    observer_id = user.id
  )

### Add in observation 8413237
# During 303 validation script, this observation was incorrectly identified
# as Ephemeroptera, instead of Plecoptera
incorrect_obs_to_add <- incorrect_obs |>
  select(
    taxon_order_id:inaturalist_url,
    odd_cases,
    fave_image,
    lat:observer_id
  ) |>
  # Add information about incorrect ID
  mutate(
    cannot_identify = TRUE,
    inat_id_corrected = TRUE,
    obs_issues = "Incorrect order-level ID",
    order_id_corrected = "Plecoptera"
  )

# Final dataset
excluded_observations <- bind_rows(excluded_observations, incorrect_obs_to_add)
```

```{r}
#| label: finalize-excluded-observations-image-metadata
excluded_observations_images_meta <- excluded_observations |>
  select(taxon_order_id:inaturalist_url) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(here(L1_data_dir, "101b_images_metadata_ETF_EPT.csv")),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  ) |>
  select(-species_label, -save_dir) |>
  rename(aws_image_url = clean_url) |>
  mutate(image_id = as.double(str_extract(img_name, "(?<=img)\\d+"))) |>
  relocate(image_id, .after = inaturalist_url)
```


# Metadata descriptions

## ETF-EPT-iNat-2025 Dataset

| Column number | Column name | Column description | Values | Column data class | 
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1] | `taxon_order_id` | Aquatic insect order identification | `Ephemeroptera`, `Plecoptera`, or `Trichoptera` | string |
| [2] | `observation_id` | Observation ID number on iNaturalist | eg., `12345` | double |
| [3] | `inaturalist_url` | URL to access observation on the iNaturalist platform | e.g., `https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/12345` | string |
| [4] | `life_stage` | Life stage of organism contained in observation images | `Adult`, `Immature`, `Eggs` | string |
| [5] | `evidence_type` | Type of evidence in image | `Nymph to adult exuviae`, `Nymph-related evidence`, `Eggs`, `Organism` | string |
| [6] | `multiple_specimen_present` | Multiple specimen of the same insect order of the observation present | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [7] | `human_present` | presence of human skin, hands, fingers, body, etc. in observation image(s) | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [8] | `collection_technique` | Technique used to collect organism in the observation | `In a net or container`, `Under microscope`, `From light trap`, `No technique` [may be wild/artificial background] | string |
| [9] | `preserved_specimen` | dead specimen under microscope or in container, may be pinned | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [10] | `interaction_predation` | Predation interaction involving the organism in the observation | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical |
| [11] | `interaction_flower` | Association interaction involving the organism in the observation (presence of organism on flower(s)) | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical |
| [12] | `interaction_reproduction` | Reproduction interaction involving the organism in the observation | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical |
| [13] | `interaction_fungus_parasitism` | Fungus parasitism interaction involving the organism in the observation | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical |
| [14] | `odd_cases` | Other notes indicating other potentially valuable or interesting information within images | x | string |
| [15] | `fave_image` | Favorite images or observations to use for research communication & visualization purposes | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [16] | `lat` | Latitudinal coordinate of the observation | e.g., `39.217914` | double |
| [17] | `long` | Longitudinal coordinate of the observation | e.g., `-77.316365` | double |
| [18] | `quality_grade` | Quality grade status of the observation | `needs_id` or `research` | string |
| [19] | `observed_date` | Date on which the observation was observed | e.g., `2025-10-31` | string |
| [20] | `uuid` | Universally unique identifier for the observation | e.g., `73b8a2b0-3726-4d0b-98ff-feb22abd1279` | string |
| [21] | `license_code` | Creative Commons license associated with the observation | e.g., `cc-by-nc` | string |
| [22] | `observer_id` | Unique iNaturalist ID for the user who created the observation | e.g., `12345` | integer |


## ETF-EPT-iNat-2025 with image metadata

| Column number | Column name | Column description | Values | Column data class | 
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1] | `taxon_order_id` | Aquatic insect order identification | `Ephemeroptera`, `Plecoptera`, or `Trichoptera` | string |
| [2] | `observation_id` | Observation ID number on iNaturalist | eg., `12345` | double |
| [3] | `inaturalist_url` | URL to access observation on the iNaturalist platform | e.g., `https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/12345` | string |
| [4] | `image_id` | Image ID number associated with the image(s) of the observation | eg., `12345` | double |
| [5] | `aws_image_url` | Amazon Web Services URL used to download observation images to a local drive | eg., `12345` | double |
| [6] | `img_name` | Unique file name used to assign images downloaded from Amazon Web Services to a local drive | eg., `12345` | double |


## Excluded-Observations Dataset

| Column number | Column name | Column description | Values | Column data class | 
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1] | `taxon_order_id` | Aquatic insect order identification | `Ephemeroptera`, `Plecoptera`, or `Trichoptera` | string |
| [2] | `observation_id` | Observation ID number on iNaturalist | eg., `12345` | double |
| [3] | `inaturalist_url` | URL to access observation on the iNaturalist platform | e.g., `https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/12345` | string |
| [4] | `odd_cases` | Other notes indicating other potentially valuable or interesting information within images | x | string |
| [5] | `fave_image` | Favorite images or observations to use for research communication & visualization purposes | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [6] | `cannot_identify` | could not identify to an EPT order for some reason described column `obs_issues` | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [7] | `inat_id_corrected` | ID corrected/updated on iNaturalist | `TRUE`, `FALSE` | logical | 
| [8] | `obs_issues` | reason for an image not being annotated or being unable to annotate | `Missing image` (no image was downloaded due to CC rights (see 101_get_EPT_images.qmd for more info)), `Duplicate image` (observation image is visually duplicate to another observation), `Uncertain ID` (unsure whether observation is EPT due to image resolution or lack of diagnostic characters), `Copyright image` (image has copyright issues identified by me), `Incorrect order-level ID` (order-level identification is incorrect), `NA` [NA = no issues with observation] | string | 
| [9] | `order_id_corrected` | the corrected identification of the organism in the image | e.g., `Pterygota` | string | 
| [10] | `lat` | Latitudinal coordinate of the observation | e.g., `39.217914` | double |
| [11] | `long` | Longitudinal coordinate of the observation | e.g., `-77.316365` | double |
| [12] | `quality_grade` | Quality grade status of the observation | `needs_id` or `research` | string |
| [13] | `observed_date` | Date on which the observation was observed | e.g., `2025-10-31` | string |
| [14] | `uuid` | Universally unique identifier for the observation | e.g., `73b8a2b0-3726-4d0b-98ff-feb22abd1279` | string |
| [15] | `license_code` | Creative Commons license associated with the observation | e.g., `cc-by-nc` | string |
| [16] | `observer_id` | Unique iNaturalist ID for the user who created the observation | e.g., `12345` | integer |


## Excluded-Observations Dataset with image metadata

| Column number | Column name | Column description | Values | Column data class | 
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1] | `taxon_order_id` | Aquatic insect order identification | `Ephemeroptera`, `Plecoptera`, or `Trichoptera` | string |
| [2] | `observation_id` | Observation ID number on iNaturalist | eg., `12345` | double |
| [3] | `inaturalist_url` | URL to access observation on the iNaturalist platform | e.g., `https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/12345` | string |
| [4] | `image_id` | Image ID number associated with the image(s) of the observation | eg., `12345` | double |
| [5] | `aws_image_url` | Amazon Web Services URL used to download observation images to a local drive | eg., `12345` | double |
| [6] | `img_name` | Unique file name used to assign images downloaded from Amazon Web Services to a local drive | eg., `12345` | double |


# Export datasets

```{r}
#| label: export-data
export_list_rds <- list(
  "ETF-EPT-iNat-2025.rds" = ETF_EPT_iNat_2025,
  "ETF-EPT-iNat-2025-image-metadata.rds" = ETF_EPT_iNat_2025_images_meta,
  "excluded-observations.rds" = excluded_observations,
  "excluded-observations-image-metadata.rds" = excluded_observations_images_meta
)

export_list_csv <- list(
  "ETF-EPT-iNat-2025.csv" = ETF_EPT_iNat_2025,
  "ETF-EPT-iNat-2025-image-metadata.csv" = ETF_EPT_iNat_2025_images_meta,
  "excluded-observations.csv" = excluded_observations,
  "excluded-observations-image-metadata.csv" = excluded_observations_images_meta
)

iwalk(export_list_rds, ~ write_rds(.x, file = here(L4_data_dir, .y)))
iwalk(export_list_csv, ~ write_csv(.x, file = here(L4_data_dir, .y)))
```
